open_points.subject: 01_models.md:Data-provider enumerations and row models (2026-11-08)
open_points.text: `TransportGuardRefusal` — closed enum: `untrusted_host | allowed_preflight | unlisted_preflight_origin | logout_origin_mismatch | oversized_body | rate_limited`, the responses the transport guard produces (A25).
open_points.question: Is `allowed_preflight` a refusal produced by the transport guard, or a successful transport outcome that must not be a member of `TransportGuardRefusal`?
options: `allowed_preflight` is a refusal despite its name
`allowed_preflight` is successful and the enumeration represents all guard outcomes rather than refusals
`allowed_preflight` is successful and must be removed from `TransportGuardRefusal`
open_points.default_guess: Treat `allowed_preflight` as a successful outcome and rename or split the taxonomy so it is not modeled as a refusal.

witness.initial: A browser sends a valid preflight request from an allowed origin.
events: The transport guard classifies the request as `allowed_preflight`.
The HTTP layer consumes that classification.
outcomes: Because every member is a `TransportGuardRefusal`, the HTTP layer handles it as a refusal.
Because `allowed_preflight` denotes permission, the HTTP layer returns a successful preflight response.
witness.observer: The browser sees whether the permitted cross-origin request can proceed.

open_points.subject: 01_models.md:Model M43 — SupportedContractVersion
open_points.text: one accepted version of an external contract (A7). / **Fields:** `version: int`. / Read only as rows of the constant SUPPORTED_SNAPSHOT_CONTRACT_VERSIONS and SUPPORTED_OCR_CONTRACT_VERSIONS / Two rows with equal fields are the same fact of the table.
open_points.question: Does a supported-version fact include the external contract it applies to, or is the same integer-valued row one identity across the snapshot and OCR contracts?
options: Identity is only `version`, so equal version numbers in both constants are the same fact
Identity is `(contract, version)`, with the enclosing constant supplying the contract
Add an explicit contract field so each supported-version fact is self-identifying
open_points.default_guess: Make the contract part of identity, preferably as an explicit field.

witness.initial: Snapshot contract version 1 is supported while OCR contract version 1 is not supported.
events: A producer publishes a snapshot with `contract_version` 1 and it is accepted.
An operator later submits a confirmed OCR contract carrying `contract_version` 1.
outcomes: An implementation treating equal `version: 1` rows as the same supported-contract fact accepts the OCR contract.
An implementation scoping support by the enclosing snapshot or OCR constant rejects the OCR contract as unsupported.
witness.observer: The authenticated operator sees whether the expense intake is accepted.
